review_method: Source-order full read of all 1200 candidate IDs, including overlap re-reads for ranges truncated by the GitHub output. The fixed English patch was used as the correction baseline and rationale for localization choices; Japanese was consulted only where needed to resolve semantic ambiguity or an apparent fixed-English-reference defect. Korean was judged for accuracy, naturalness, register, terminology, referent/subject/direction handling, and obvious text breakage. Final result: 25 EDIT and 1175 KEEP, no exclusions and no propagation. All 25 proposed before-values were verified against current Korean, and semantic commit a8ee4c98a8497965d4c4c18fc10246c2bf832f9d passed exact-before application, zero-layout-drift checks, the existing Korean gates, and the English-consumer storage/effective-layout contract before review-basis registration. No out-of-scope historical cleanup was performed.
